architecture.runtime_volume: The live ARaftSimWaterSurfaceActor remains the sole owner of Zambezi gameplay-water geometry. Its non-colliding wet-cell volume core now uses MI_RaftSim_ZambeziBatoka_LiveVolumeWaterV2 through the shared raft-transmitting Single Layer Water parent.
architecture.bank_edge: The shared parent now multiplies its pre-existing optical-depth opacity by the smooth station/lateral wet-cell coverage already stored in live-core vertex alpha. Zambezi widens the render-only blend from 4.5 m to 7.5 m, approximately three 2.5 m sampled cells, so the optical body fades at both banks instead of ending at an opaque rectangular cell edge.
architecture.runtime_detail: The live Default Lit detail skin is reduced to 0.025 calm / 0.13 active coverage. First-party flow-normal and foam-lace textures remain bounded by live solver foam and speed channels and cannot paint water or whitewater into dry cells.
architecture.capture_water: The opaque physical-corridor ribbon remains available for deterministic editor review but is tagged RaftSimCaptureOnlyStaticWater and hidden during gameplay.
architecture.authority_boundary: The new coverage multiply, bank blend, colours, reflection, roughness, smoothing, opacity, and foam parameters are render-only. Cooked depth, velocity, wet/dry state, curved stationing, bathymetry, collision, buoyancy, raft forces, rapid detection, and scoring are unchanged.

fixed_camera_comparison.method: Matched 1280x720 offscreen gameplay captures at the identical saved-map launch transform, three-second crew-command timing, camera offsets, lighting, and scalability. Water luminance excludes rows 0-269 and the central raft/crew rectangle. Right-bank edge measurements cover x=850-1279, y=270-344 and are descriptive renderer measurements rather than acceptance thresholds.
fixed_camera_comparison.verdict: Retain as a bounded gameplay-water improvement. The matched image reduces the brightest launch-water fraction by 83.5 percent at the 0.90 luminance threshold, eliminates pixels above 0.95 in the measured water mask, and reduces the sampled right-bank p99 vertical edge by 14.8 percent. The coarse source terrain and wet-cell tessellation remain visible, so this does not constitute photoreal acceptance or a surveyed shoreline fix.
